watched #premam : I havent watched the original version so my thought was not pre-programmed……Need to mention 4 main ppl, NagaChaitanya has tried his best and mostly succedded in giving best performance till date and was stylish in remaining 2 getups.

Praween : to be frank, he has carried the whole movie with his comedy timing n expressions

Srinivas : He played a major role during the last 30 mins of the movie

Shruthi Hassan : she played the char with such an ease

music & bgm are good and suites the plot….the visuals in evvare song were delight to watch

Dialogues were verybgood and loved this one “Prema Dvesham Kopam ivani feelings….manam kavalante feelings peruguthayi vadu anukunte tagipothayi”

To cut it short…..Love/Romantic genere movies have always made me feel bore, but this movie has tried to keep me engaged due to its entertainment, probably would have felt horrible for me if the comedy was missing. Its Naa Autograph minus heavy emotions plus light hearted comedy
